title: Silence measured on the whole connection over 60 s, not per contract over 3 s (G-07-5)
reference_behaviour: A connection counts as dead only after 60 s with no packet of any kind on it.
ours: A price frame must arrive within 3 s or the live row goes waiting, so a quiet market can flip it (hypothesis, unmeasured). REQ-114 AC-1 measures silence on the connection (row 11).
